outcome: The resolver validates one settings document per scope, reads user and repository files only from the fixed operator-owned locations and refuses every other source, and resolves them so that the effective delivery is always the Mailbox, a push request is only recorded, a block floor at repository or user scope holds the guard mode at block, and extensions are stored without interpretation.
limits: Offline synthetic fixtures and temporary Git repositories on one POSIX host. Class 1-syntactic. The caller supplies the working-tree roots and the configuration directory: no CLI subcommand reads these settings yet, so the Git observation of working trees is not wired. The floor is as strong as the file permissions of the operator-owned files; the permissions of the directories above them are not checked, and a writer with the operator's own permissions can change them. guardMode is validated and never enforced. No host, Claude Code, G1 or independent-review claim.
